items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: Tommy Turrentine, who is Stanley Turrentine’s older brother

ctx.x: What were your early playing experiences like, leading up to your experience with the Basie band.

Early on, yeah, well at first, my first job was with Tommy Turrentine, who is Stanley Turrentine’s older brother. And J.C. Moses was in the band, and Booker Ervin was in the band, he’d just got out of the Air Force and was on his way to the Big Apple, New York. And after that Rahsann Roland Kirk was coming through town on the way to New York so he joined this band, so I had a lot of early exposure, you know, early experiences.
And what kind of people did you listen to? I mean was there guys on records that you tried to learn from?
